questions: Why did the perf-gate flake on PR #101?
How to fix without blinding the gate?

findings.detail: PR #101 (advanced-gated) failed gate only on sub-µs concurrent_resource_ops at 2.3-2.4x; re-run passed 13/13 unchanged -> CI noise.
2.0x is below sub-µs benches' CI noise floor (B-34b F4 predicted).
fix = noise floor (skip FAIL for baseline median <~1000ns; still report; gate µs+ unchanged), not a higher global threshold.
